Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

A optometrist and a sales clerk were talking about how they ended up in the jobs they did. The optometrist recalled having a hard time before college, even not passing some classes, and the sales clerk started their story talking about having been a member of the honors society back in high school. Who failed classes in high school?
A. Cannot be determined
B. The optometrist
C. The sales clerk
